# verifyComponentConsistency reports a vdom node withheld from the DOM as a mismatch

## Context

Measured on dev `e3d83f1b91` while probing `TabHeaderActionsNL` (#17844's census row). After a tab drag that leaves the container unfocused, `app.verifyComponentConsistency(tabBarId)` (the Neural Link's `verify_component_consistency`) returns:

```
consistent: false, counts: {dom: 5, items: 6, vdom: 6}
mismatches: [{type: 'order-or-membership', surfaces: ['vdom', 'dom'],
  a: [tab-1, tab-2, tab-3, spacer, next-tab, previous-tab], b: [tab-1, tab-2, tab-3, spacer, next-tab]}]
```

The missing DOM member is the withdrawn `previous-tab` action. With focus back in the container (the action revealed) the same call reports `consistent: true` with six nodes on every surface.

## The Problem

`Neo.ai.client.ComponentService#verifyComponentConsistency` (`src/ai/client/ComponentService.mjs:165`–`:178`) reads the vdom surface as every `cn` entry's `componentId` or `id`, then `diffChildSurfaces` compares that list to the rendered child ids. A vdom node stamped `removeDom: true` is, by contract, present in the vdom and absent from the DOM: `toolbar.Base#applyContextualActionState` withdraws a focus-gated action exactly that way and raises `domWithheld` so `show()` keeps it out (#18069, `src/toolbar/Base.mjs:277`–`:278`). So every toolbar with a withdrawn action is "inconsistent" to the tool, and a spec that asserts consistency after an interaction that unfocuses the container reads a defect where there is none. The checker cannot tell a withheld node from a dropped one.

## The Architectural Reality

- `verifyComponentConsistency` builds `vdomIds` from `component.getVdomItemsRoot?.()?.cn || component.vdom?.cn`; the `removeDom` flag sits on those same nodes.
- `ComponentService.diffChildSurfaces({componentId, domIds, itemIds, vdomIds})` is static and pure, covered by `test/playwright/unit/ai/client/ComponentService.spec.mjs` (arms at `:79`–`:118`: consistent surfaces, duplicates, items-vs-vdom order, missing DOM root).
- `items` still holds the withdrawn instance, so the items-vs-vdom comparison must keep seeing it; only the DOM expectation changes.

## The Fix

`src/ai/client/ComponentService.mjs`:
1. `verifyComponentConsistency` collects `withheldIds`, the ids of `cn` entries with `removeDom === true`, beside `vdomIds`.
2. `diffChildSurfaces` takes `withheldIds` (default empty): the vdom-vs-dom comparison runs on `vdomIds` minus `withheldIds`; a withheld id that *is* in the DOM is its own mismatch (`type: 'withheld-node-rendered'`). The result carries `withheldIds` so a reader sees what was excused.
3. Two arms in `ComponentService.spec.mjs`: a withheld node absent from the DOM is consistent; a withheld node present in the DOM is reported.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `diffChildSurfaces` with one withheld id absent from `domIds` reports no mismatch and lists the id under `withheldIds`.
- [ ] AC-2: `diffChildSurfaces` with a withheld id present in `domIds` reports `withheld-node-rendered`.
- [ ] AC-3: red-first: AC-1's arm fails on dev with the `order-or-membership` mismatch.
- [ ] AC-4: `TabHeaderActionsNL:288` ("post-drag items, VDOM, and DOM remain exact") passes with the container unfocused after the drag, once the arm reaches it (it currently dies at `:269`, #19281).

## Out of Scope

- The focus loss that unfocuses the container after a tab drag: #19281.
- Any other reader of `removeDom`.
